newsitem.title: THAILAND: North Korean ship to lift 10,000T of Thai rice.
newsitem.headline: North Korean ship to lift 10,000T of Thai rice.

text.p: A North Korean ship will berth at Bangkok port to lift about 10,000 tonnes of Thai rice in early September, exporters said on Wednesday.
The exporters said the rice cargo, mostly A-1 super broken and other low grades, would be bought directly by the North Korean embassy from many Thai companies on FOB terms.
They did not have any other information.
A trader said North Korea had lifted at least 10,000 tonnes from his company in the past two months.
North Korea has no government-to-government deals for rice purchases with Thailand.

The Thai Rice Exporters Association said North Korea lifted 55,993 tonnes of Thai rice during January/July, of which 32,159 tonnes were 35 percent white, 9,755 tonnes were A-1 super broken, and 14,079 tonnes were loonzain.
